# eth_wallet_ui — Ethereum Wallet

> View EVM assets and activity across enabled networks, and send on an explicitly selected chain. Holds no key material.

## App-to-app intents

- provides `{'intent': 'evm.transactions.send', 'params': [{'name': 'calls', 'type': 'array', 'required': True, 'description': 'The transactions to send, in order: [{ to, value?, data?, gasLimit?, label?, meta? }]'}, {'name': 'purpose', 'type': 'string', 'required': True, 'description': "What the human is told the bundle is for, in the requester's words"}, {'name': 'chainId', 'type': 'number', 'required': False, 'description': "Must be enabled and in the current device scope; absent uses the wallet's local Send-network selection"}, {'name': 'from', 'type': 'string', 'required': False, 'description': "One of the wallet's accounts; absent means the selected one"}, {'name': 'tier', 'type': 'string', 'required': False, 'description': 'slow, normal or fast; absent means normal'}]}`
- uses `{'intent': 'evm.signing.approve', 'cardinality': 'single'}`
- uses `{'intent': 'evm.accounts.manage', 'cardinality': 'single'}`
- uses `{'intent': 'evm.rpc.configure', 'cardinality': 'single'}`
- uses `{'intent': 'evm.verified_routing.operate', 'cardinality': 'single'}`
- uses `{'intent': 'evm.token_lists.configure', 'cardinality': 'single'}`
